name: anilist-my-proxy
description: Categorized AniList GraphQL proxy with paginated category endpoints, plus Jikan-style item endpoints addressed by explicit id source (/api/mal/{mal_id}/full|episodes, /api/anilist/{anilist_id}/full|episodes) or auto-detected generic /api/{id}/full|episodes. Server-side 4h cache. Returns both AniList id and MyAnimeList idMal. Browse endpoints: /api/season/{season}/{year} (+ /current), /api/studio/{studio}, /api/staff/{name} (+ /voice-actors, /cast aliases) — AniList-style responses, exact-key TTL cache (param change = fresh fetch).
author: Varvoul
